targets.claim: Alaska Airlines Flight 448 made an emergency landing on Monday.
The worker was from a contractor handling loading the luggage (Menzies Aviation).
The worker fell asleep in the cargo hold.
The worker was taken to a hospital as a precaution.
The worker passed a drug test and was later discharged.
The passengers were spooked by the incident.
Alaska Airlines is investigating the incident.
All ramp employees have security badges and undergo full criminal background checks before being hired.
